topicTitle: La comunicación en la organización: interpersonal, descendente, ascendente y horizontal. Flujos y barreras de comunicación en las organizaciones. La organización y la cultura de la organización. Teorías sobre la motivación.

primaryPageAudit.notes: Communication as an essential organizational element; internal/external relationships and organizational circuits.
Coordination, culture transmission, information climate and introduction to interpersonal communication.
Perception as selection, organization and interpretation; attention and subjective construction.
Cognitive limitations, stereotypes and beginning of halo effect.
Halo continuation, selective perception, projection and Pigmalion expectation effect.
Pigmalion continuation and communication process: emitter, receiver, message, code and feedback.
Feedback/dialogue and communication axioms including congruence.
Oral and written verbal communication; introduction to non-verbal communication.
Non-verbal communication and 7/38/55 distribution reproduced by the source.
Non-verbal elements/functions and introduction to organizational communication flows.
Descending communication and beginning of ascending communication.
Ascending and horizontal communication; introduction to informal communication.
Informal communication continuation and organizational effects.
Organization in contemporary society and conceptual heterogeneity; attached to the organization mastery family.
Organization as complex/plural/changing reality and Mayntz organizational traits.
Porter-Lawler-Hackman definition and introduction to general systems theory.
Open systems, subsystems, interdependence and Schein system aspects.
Organizational culture introduction and its intangible character.
Culture definition, values, beliefs, norms and behavioral influence.
Subcultures, Schein basic assumptions and formation of culture.
Cultural socialization and transition to organizational socialization.
Organizational socialization, recruitment/selection and adaptation to role.
Cultural change in public administration, values, behaviors, service and ethics.
In-scope cultural-change continuation audited; content from III. LA DIRECCIÓN DE LAS ORGANIZACIONES excluded as adjacent nonmaterial.
Maslow hierarchy of needs.
Herzberg dual-factor theory and beginning of McClelland.
McClelland, McGregor X/Y/Z and Vroom expectations theory.
Vroom continuation, Alderfer ERC and beginning of Locke goal setting.
Locke continuation and Adams equity theory.
Post-Adams material headed Consecuencias para el voluntariado and references excluded as adjacent nonmaterial.

notes: No web, external BOE/BORM website, academy material or external substantive knowledge was used.
The canonical 30-page primary transport was read visually/multimodally; OCR was not used as substantive truth.
All nine supplementary pages were audited only for the explicitly authorized missing facets.
The historical internal label TEMA 7 was ignored; every T06 question remains associated with official topic 6.
Eight questions were generated solely to raise each of the eight distinct motivation mastery concepts from three to four source-supported primary questions; no quota-based generation was performed.
Three editorial warnings were hardened without changing their canonical answers.
Post-scope direction material and the p111 volunteer/references block were treated as IGNORE_NONMATERIAL, not source gaps.
